llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple characteristics of a scam: it offers a wide variety of unrelated products at unusually low prices; it uses the name of a legitimate seafood company to sell non-seafood products (electronics, fashion, etc.), which is inconsistent with the real business; the contact email uses a suspicious domain not suitable for professional business use; and the domain lacks transparent ownership details. Existing reviews indicate the real company only sells seafood, making this site an impersonation and clear scam.
